explanation: erdosproblems.com/503: Blokhuis [Bl84] showed |A| ≤ C(d+2, 2) for isosceles sets in ℝ^d. The Lean statement: every ncard of an isosceles A ⊆ ℝ^n is ≤ C(n+2, 2). Since infinite A would have ncard 0, the statement as an upper bound on all realised ncard values is exactly the claim for finite sets. Faithful.
